channel.title: AzRoleWatcher
channel.description: Continuously monitor roles and permissions in Microsoft Entra ID and Azure.

item.title: 🆕 ADDED Azure role
item.description:
Id: 9697f39a-3a08-4fc8-ab07-674a0d5cacdd
Display name: Microsoft Discovery Storage Container Contributor - Preview
Description: Grants management of storage assets within Microsoft.Discovery storage containers: allows reading a storage container and creating, reading, updating, and deleting the storage assets within it, including checking the status of asynchronous storage asset operations. Cannot create, update, or delete the storage container itself, and does not grant access to the underlying Azure Storage blob data. Intended to be assigned alongside Discovery project roles. This role is in preview and subject to change.
Link: https://management.azure.com/9697f39a-3a08-4fc8-ab07-674a0d5cacdd?api-version=2022-04-01

item.title: 🆕 ADDED Azure role
item.description:
Id: a51eacd1-6976-43ce-b6b6-83585e3639f0
Display name: Microsoft Discovery Storage Container Reader - Preview
Description: Read-only access to Microsoft.Discovery storage containers and the storage assets within them: allows reading a storage container and listing/reading its storage assets. Does not allow creating, modifying, or deleting storage assets or containers, and does not grant access to the underlying Azure Storage blob data. Intended to be assigned alongside Discovery project roles. This role is in preview and subject to change.
Link: https://management.azure.com/a51eacd1-6976-43ce-b6b6-83585e3639f0?api-version=2022-04-01
